info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Auto Insurance Quotes Coverages-v2-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows users to list coverages associated with auto insurance quotes. It serves to provide detailed insights into the various coverage options available for prospective policyholders. Typically used by insurance agents, brokers, and applications that assist users in comparing quotes, this functionality enables consumers to make informed decisions. Retrieve comprehensive coverage data to facilitate better client interactions and optimize insurance offerings.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed coverage information related to insurance quotes. It provides insights into the options available and the specifics of what each quote entails.

requestBody.description: This request body provides the necessary parameters to retrieve coverage quotes. It must contain the relevant information specified in the schema to ensure accurate processing of the request.
